title: Link Sender
description: Simple plugin to create and send clickable links in Minecraft chat. Manage links easily with commands and permissions.
body:
# 🔗 Link-Sender

**Link-Sender** is a lightweight Paper plugin that allows players to create, manage, and share clickable links directly in Minecraft chat. 🌐 Perfect for servers that want to provide easy access to websites, social media, Discord servers, or any external links.

## ✨ Features

- 🛠️ Create and manage links easily via commands  
- 📤 Send clickable links to yourself or other players  
- 🔒 Customizable permissions for full control  
- ⚙️ Works with Minecraft Paper 1.21+  

## 📜 Commands

- `/link create <name> <url>` – ➕ Create a new link (requires `link.create` permission)  
- `/link delete <name>` – ❌ Delete an existing link (requires `link.delete`)  
- `/link list` – 📋 List all available links (requires `link.list`)  
- `/link reload` – 🔄 Reload links from `links.yml` (requires `link.reload`)  
- `/link <name>` – 👤 Show a clickable link to yourself (requires `link.me`)  
- `/link <name> <player>` – 📨 Send a clickable link to another player (requires `link.send`)  

## 🔐 Permissions

- `link.create` – ➕ Allows creating links  
- `link.delete` – ❌ Allows deleting links  
- `link.list` – 📋 Allows viewing the link list  
- `link.reload` – 🔄 Allows reloading the links file  
- `link.send` – 📨 Allows sending links to other players  
- `link.me` – 👤 Allows sending links to yourself  
- `link.*` – 🌟 All permissions  
- `link.op` – 🛡️ Operator-level permissions  
- `link.default` – ⚙️ Default basic permissions  

## 📦 Installation

1. 📥 Download the latest `.jar` from Modrinth.  
2. 📂 Place it in your server's `plugins` folder.  
3. ▶️ Start or reload your server.  
4. 📝 Configure your links in `plugins/Link-Sender/links.yml`.  

## 📝 Notes

- 👥 Only players can execute link commands.  
- 💬 Clickable links use Minecraft's Adventure text API for a clean in-chat experience.  
- ⚙️ Requires Paper server 1.21+.  

---

## 🚀 Future ideas

- 🎨 Custom clickable message formats (colors, hover text, prefixes)
- ⏳ Cooldowns to prevent link spam
- 🔗 GUI menu to browse and click links easily
- 🔒 Private links (only visible to specific players or groups) 
- ⏳ Cooldowns para evitar spam de enlaces
- 🎯 Permission-based link visibility
